title: The grievance is remembered
odia:
କୁଲାରେ କାଟିଲି ଲାଉ
ସବୁ ଦିନ କଥା ମନରେ ଅଛି
ଦିନେ ତ ସାଧିବି ଦାଉ।
literal_meaning: I cut a bottle gourd on a winnowing tray; I remember the matters of all those days; one day I shall settle the score.
meaning_odia: ଆଗର ସବୁ କଥା ମନେ ରଖି ଦିନେ ତାହାର ପ୍ରତିଶୋଧ ନେବାକୁ ବକ୍ତା କହୁଛି। ତୁରନ୍ତ କିଛି ନକଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଅସନ୍ତୋଷ ମନରୁ ଯାଇନାହିଁ; ଶେଷ ପଦରେ ପରେ ଦାଉ ସାଧିବାର ଧମକ ଅଛି।
explanation: The speaker has kept earlier grievances in mind and promises to settle them later. The last line makes the intent sharper than merely remembering or postponing a reply. It voices a lingering grudge.
usage_example: In a fictional quarrel, someone recalls several earlier slights and quotes the saying to make clear that the dispute is still alive. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The everyday image of cutting a bottle gourd on a winnowing tray opens the verse. ଲାଉ rhymes with ଦାଉ, carrying that ordinary image into the pointed promise at the end. The words supply no account of what originally caused the quarrel.

odia_summary: ପୁରୁଣା ଅସନ୍ତୋଷ ମନେ ରଖି ପରେ ଦାଉ ସାଧିବାର କଥା।
english_summary: A remembered grievance becomes a promise to settle the score later.
